name: Ansar SEO – WordPress SEO, Meta Tags & On-Page SEO
author: themeansar

sections.description:
Ansar SEO is a lightweight WordPress SEO plugin built for users who want essential SEO features without the complexity of large all-in-one plugins.

Optimize every post and page directly inside the Gutenberg editor with an intuitive SEO panel. Add SEO titles, meta descriptions, canonical URLs, robots directives, and other important metadata while seeing real-time optimization feedback.

Built with performance in mind, Ansar SEO focuses on the SEO features that matter most, helping search engines understand your content while keeping your website fast.

Features

  • SEO Title editor with live preview
  • Meta Description editor
  • Canonical URL support
  • Open Graph metadata
  • X (Twitter) Card metadata
  • Character and pixel length guidance
  • Clean Gutenberg sidebar integration
  • Lightweight and performance-focused
  • Works with any well-coded WordPress theme
  • Developer-friendly and extensible

Perfect for bloggers, businesses, agencies, WooCommerce stores, news websites, and developers looking for a modern SEO solution without unnecessary bloat.
sections.faq:
Is Ansar SEO compatible with Gutenberg?

Yes. Ansar SEO adds a dedicated SEO panel inside the WordPress Block Editor, allowing you to manage your SEO settings while editing content.

Does it work with any WordPress theme?

Yes. Ansar SEO works with any standards-compliant WordPress theme.

Does it support canonical URLs?

Yes. You can define canonical URLs for individual posts and pages.

Is the plugin lightweight?

Yes. Ansar SEO is designed to provide essential SEO functionality while minimizing performance impact.

What license does the plugin use?

Ansar SEO is licensed under GPLv3 or later.
